setup: By the central limit theorem the sum of \(n = [[n]]\) copies is approximately normal with mean \(n\mu\) and standard deviation \(\sigma\sqrt{n}\); standardise \(x = [[x]]\).

steps.say: The mean of the sum: \(n\mu = [[n]] \cdot [[mu]] = [[nmu]]\), so \(x - n\mu = [[x]] - [[nmu]] = [[dev]]\).
